title: Robodo Solar Panel for Science Project and Models 3.8 Volt 1 Ampere-Black
description: This 3.8V 1A Solar Panel is an ideal power source for science projects, models, and small solar-powered devices. With a 3.8V output and a 1A current capacity, it can efficiently power small electronics, motors, and light bulbs. Its compact size makes it perfect for use in DIY projects, educational models, and experiments that demonstrate solar energy. The black-colored panel is durable, lightweight, and designed to be easily integrated into various setups for science projects.This is a relatively small, yet efficient solar panel, capable of generating a modest amount of electrical power from sunlight. Solar panels convert sunlight into direct current (DC) electricity using photovoltaic cells, making them an ideal source for renewable energy applications. With an output of 3.8 watts, this panel can power low-power devices or serve as a starting point for experimenting with solar energy in a science project.Solar panels operate on the principle of converting sunlight into electricity using photovoltaic (PV) cells. When sunlight hits the solar panel’s surface, it excites the electrons within the material, causing them to move and generate electricity. The amount of energy the panel produces depends on various factors like: Intensity of sunlight: The brighter the sunlight, the more electricity is generated. Angle of the panel: To maximize efficiency, the panel should be positioned so it directly faces the sun. Duration of sunlight exposure: The longer the panel is exposed to sunlight, the more energy it can produce.
